name: BoardWhereNext - Default
description: The whole far end of a worked map: things to try, directions to take, what is being learned and what is still open. This was a separate screen that replaced the board and opened with a declaration about a finish line, on a tool whose case is that there is not one. The order here is deliberately not a report's — it leads with the MOVES, because someone who opens the far end of their own map is asking what now.
